HoldedAPIKey.title: Holded API Key
HoldedAPIKey.x-credential-instructions: Paste a Holded API v2 API key. NoClick sends it as a Bearer token to api.holded.com. Grant contacts:contacts.read to verify the connection, plus the read or write permissions for the resources you automate (contacts, invoicing, inventory and projects). Use a key for the published v2 API.

number.description:
Custom document number. Use only if you do not want to assign the number via one of the numbering series created in Holded (e.g. to replicate exactly the number from another platform). The value is saved as-is, without correlativity validation. If this field is sent, number_line_id is ignored.

Warning: do not use a value that matches the format of an existing numbering series. The series keeps its own counter regardless of manually assigned numbers -- e.g. if a series is at number 24 and you manually create a document with 27, the series will keep issuing 25, 26, and when it reaches 27 it will try to create a number that already exists: the request will fail and the series will have lost its correlativity and order. If you need custom numbering, use a prefix or format that does not match any active series, or manage every document in that series with number_line_id.
number.title: Number

number_line_id.description: Identifier of the numbering series used to automatically assign the next correlative number. This is the recommended option, as it preserves the document order and correlativity. If both fields are sent, number takes priority and number_line_id is ignored.
number_line_id.title: Number Line Id

shipping_address.description: Structured shipping address. Omit to leave unchanged (update) or unset (create). Pass null to clear it. The address fields (name, address_line_1, city, ...) are only used with type=manual; with billing, hidden or contact they are ignored. Use type=contact with contact_address_id to point to an address saved on the contact.

value.description: Value stored in the custom field
value.title: Value

type.description: Kind of line. `product` and `service` are billable lines whose amount (`units` × `price`, less `discount`, plus `taxes`) is added to the document total. `title` is a section-header line that shows only its `name` and carries no amount — it does not contribute to the total. Other values are special-purpose lines. Omit this field for an ordinary priced line item.
type.title: Type

product_id.description: Identifier of an existing catalog product to link this line to. The id is stored as a reference associating the line with the product (used for stock and reporting). Each line field (`price`, `taxes`, ...) is taken as sent; api2 stores the line values you provide and does not itself read them back from the product record. Leave unset for a free-text line that is not a catalog product.
product_id.title: Product Id

variant_id.description: Identifier of the variant of `product_id` to link this line to. Requires `product_id`. Leave unset for a line without variant.
variant_id.title: Variant Id

service_id.description: Identifier of an existing catalog service to link this line to. When provided, the line type is automatically set to `service`. Leave unset for a free-text line that is not a catalog service.
service_id.title: Service Id

taxes.description: Tax keys applied to this line. When omitted, the contact default tax applies, or, if the contact has none, the account default tax when the request asks for it, else no tax.
taxes.title: Taxes

cost_price.description: Unit cost price for margin calculations

supplied.description: Whether this line is a supply expense (suplido) paid on behalf of the client. Excluded from the tax base.

retention.description: IRPF withholding percentage to apply to this line. Reduces the invoice total.
retention.title: Retention

status.description: Filter invoices by payment status. "pending" matches invoices with no payment recorded and "partial" those collected in part; both still owe a balance. "outstanding" returns the two together, "overdue" narrows that set to a due date already past, and "completed" returns the settled ones.
status.title: Status

start_date.description: Filter invoices from this date. Accepts ISO 8601 datetime (e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00) or date only (e.g. 2026-01-01)
start_date.title: Start Date

end_date.description: Filter invoices up to this date. Accepts ISO 8601 datetime (e.g. 2026-12-31T23:59:59+00:00) or date only (e.g. 2026-12-31). A date without a time (YYYY-MM-DD) includes that whole day; a value with a time is applied exactly as sent.
end_date.title: End Date

due_date_start.description: Filter invoices whose DUE date is on or after this date. Accepts ISO 8601 datetime or date only (e.g. 2026-01-01).
due_date_start.title: Due Date Start

due_date_end.description: Filter invoices whose DUE date is on or before this date. Accepts ISO 8601 datetime or date only (e.g. 2026-03-12). A date without a time (YYYY-MM-DD) includes that whole day; a value with a time is applied exactly as sent.
due_date_end.title: Due Date End

sort.description: Sort order for results. Prefix with - for descending.
sort.title: Sort

approval_status.description: Filter by approval status. Use "draft" for unapproved invoices, "approved" for approved ones.
approval_status.title: Approval Status

accounting_account_num.description: Filter invoices that have at least one line booked to this accounting account, identified by its numeric PGC code (e.g. 70000000 for "Ventas de mercaderias"). Only the numeric code is accepted; a non-numeric value returns 400. Returns 404 if no accounting account with that number exists in the tenant. When called through the AI assistant, an account name is resolved to its code automatically before the request reaches this endpoint.
accounting_account_num.title: Accounting Account Num
